# BESTMT4EA

> Myfxbook-verified MT4 and MT5 expert advisors (EAs), indicators and free
> trading tools. Each page states the broker, the account type (real or demo) and the maximum
> drawdown behind any figure shown. Products are sold with a per-account licence and delivered
> from the BestMT4EA dashboard.

This file is a map for AI assistants and answer engines. Every link is a public
page with a short note on what it contains. Long-form guides are written to be
read directly: they state the problem, the honest limits, and the numbers behind
any claim. Performance figures come from real Myfxbook accounts and are labelled
live or demo.

## Start here

- [All expert advisors](https://bestmt4ea.com/shop/): The full catalogue of MT4/MT5 systems with prices and licence tiers.
- [Top ranking](https://bestmt4ea.com/top-ranking/): Every system ranked by verified total gain against maximum drawdown.
- [Best MT4 EAs](https://bestmt4ea.com/best-mt4-ea/): Expert advisors built for MetaTrader 4.
- [Best MT5 EAs](https://bestmt4ea.com/best-mt5-ea/): Expert advisors built for MetaTrader 5.
- [Best forex EAs](https://bestmt4ea.com/best-forex-ea/): The whole EA catalogue ranked on one board by third-party tracked gain, with maximum drawdown and account type (real or demo) for each system, plus a methodology section and FAQ.
- [Best forex brokers](https://bestmt4ea.com/best-forex-brokers/): The brokers used to verify tracked performance.

## Guides

Long-form educational guides, each with a free downloadable worksheet or checklist. They state the method, the honest limits and make no profit claims.

- [ADX Indicator Settings for MT4: A Tested Guide](https://bestmt4ea.com/10-best-adx-indicator-strategy-settings-for-mt4-powerful-secrets-for-winning-trades/): What the ADX measures, which MT4 settings traders commonly use, how to read trend strength without treating it as a signal, and how to test ADX rules on demo.
- [Best Forex Leverage for Beginners: A Safer Starting Point](https://bestmt4ea.com/7-powerful-reasons-why-the-best-leverage-for-beginners-in-forex-leads-to-safer-profits/): Which forex leverage suits a beginner, how margin works on a standard lot, and why a modest ratio with a fixed stop is the safer way to start trading.
- [Bollinger Band Width: A Squeeze Strategy Explained](https://bestmt4ea.com/bollinger-band-width-indicator-trading-strategy/): How Bollinger Band width measures volatility, what a squeeze does and does not tell you, and how to test a squeeze breakout rule on demo with a tracker.
- [Choosing a Forex Broker for Expert Advisors](https://bestmt4ea.com/the-ultimate-guide-to-the-best-forex-brokers-for-expert-advisors/): How to check a forex broker before running an expert advisor: regulation, execution, spreads, minimum stops, account types and the rules that affect EA trading.
- [Daily Drawdown Protection for Prop Firm EAs](https://bestmt4ea.com/10-powerful-ways-to-improve-daily-drawdown-protection-for-prop-firms-via-ea-including-pro-tips/): How daily drawdown limits work in prop firm challenges, how an EA can respect them, where automation fails, and how to test the protection before a challenge.
- [Donchian Channel Breakout EA: A Testing Guide](https://bestmt4ea.com/long-form-article-donchian-channel-breakout-ea-for-commodity-trading-powerful-guide-to-automated-market-success/): How a Donchian breakout works, how an EA turns it into rules, why commodity CFDs such as gold need their own tests, and how to verify the EA before demo.
- [Dragonfly Doji at Support: How to Read It](https://bestmt4ea.com/understanding-the-dragonfly-doji-at-support-level/): What a dragonfly doji candle shows at a support level, how to measure its wicks, why confirmation matters, and how to log the pattern in a demo test safely.
- [EA Optimisation for EURUSD M5: An Honest Testing Method](https://bestmt4ea.com/9-powerful-mt4-ea-optimization-settings-for-eurusd-m5-to-boost-performance-fast/): Why optimising an EA on EURUSD M5 often overfits the past, how to split data into in-sample and out-of-sample periods, and how to test settings before demo.
- [EUR/USD Strategies for Beginners: A Testing Guide](https://bestmt4ea.com/best-eur-usd-trading-strategies-for-beginners/): Three EUR/USD approaches a beginner can test on a demo account, how to write rules for each one, and how to judge the sample before any real money is risked.
- [Fair Value Gaps in Crypto: A Detection Guide](https://bestmt4ea.com/volumetric-inverse-fair-value-gap-detection-in-cryptocurrency-trading/): How fair value gaps are defined in crypto charts, how to add volume to the test, why inverse gaps need their own rules, and how to log them on a demo account.
- [Free Mobile Apps for Learning Forex Trading](https://bestmt4ea.com/top-10-best-mobile-apps-for-learning-forex-trading-free/): How to judge a free forex learning app before you trust it: demo practice, honest risk warnings, accurate prices and no pressure to make a deposit at all.
- [Free Tools for Analysing MT4 EA Drawdowns](https://bestmt4ea.com/10-best-free-tools-for-analyzing-mt4-robot-drawdowns-powerful-guide-for-safe-forex-trading/): Measure an EA's drawdown from MT4 reports and a spreadsheet, understand depth and duration, and stress test the worst case before sizing a live account.
- [Heikin-Ashi Scalping: What the Candles Show](https://bestmt4ea.com/10-powerful-reasons-scalping-with-heikin-ashi-candles-can-boost-your-trading-success/): How Heikin-Ashi candles are calculated, why they smooth price and lag it, how a scalper can test a Heikin-Ashi rule on M1 or M5, and where the method misleads.
- [Martingale in Forex: The Risks Explained](https://bestmt4ea.com/7-critical-risks-of-what-is-a-martingale-strategy-in-forex-risks-and-how-traders-can-avoid-them-2/): What a martingale strategy does, why doubling after losses can end an account, how grid and martingale EAs hide the risk, and how to stress test the approach.
- [MT4 Journal EA Error Messages and What They Mean](https://bestmt4ea.com/mt4-journal-common-ea-error-messages-and-fixes-17-powerful-ways-to-solve-expert-advisor-issues/): A plain guide to common MT4 journal error codes an expert advisor produces, what each usually means, and how to check the cause before changing anything.
- [Paper Trading: How to Test a Strategy First](https://bestmt4ea.com/10-powerful-paper-trading-strategies-to-test-before-real-money-investment/): How to paper trade a strategy honestly before real money, with written rules, realistic costs, a fixed sample and clear criteria for moving to live trading.
- [QQE Indicator for MT4: Trend Confirmation Explained](https://bestmt4ea.com/7-powerful-ways-a-free-qqe-indicator-with-alerts-for-trend-confirmation-can-transform-your-trading/): What the QQE indicator measures, how its smoothed RSI and trailing level work, what its alerts do and do not show, and how to test a confirmation rule on demo.
- [Recovering From a Losing Streak in Forex](https://bestmt4ea.com/7-powerful-ways-to-recover-from-a-losing-forex-trading-streak-and-come-back-stronger/): What a losing streak does to a trader, how to tell bad luck from a broken plan, and a step-by-step way to cut risk and return to demo practice safely.
- [Removing an MT4 Expert Advisor Safely: Step by Step](https://bestmt4ea.com/10-powerful-tips-for-the-safe-way-to-remove-mt4-expert-advisor-without-errors/): How to remove an MT4 expert advisor without leaving orphaned trades, stray settings or error messages, with a checklist for records, open positions and files.
- [TDI Bounce Scalping: A Testing Guide](https://bestmt4ea.com/tdi-bounce-forex-scalping-strategy-7-powerful-secrets-for-consistent-profits/): What the Traders Dynamic Index measures, how a TDI bounce rule is written for scalping, why its bands can mislead, and how to test the rule on demo with a log.
- [Team Trading and Prop Firm Options Explained](https://bestmt4ea.com/top-10-powerful-team-trading-prop-firm-options-for-modern-traders/): The main ways traders work with prop firms or in teams, what each arrangement asks of you, the risks of pooled money, and the checks to make before joining one.
- [What Are Harmonic Patterns in Forex Trading?](https://bestmt4ea.com/10-powerful-reasons-why-what-are-harmonic-patterns-in-forex-trading-can-improve-your-market-results/): What harmonic patterns are, how to measure an XABCD swing with Fibonacci ratios, why the potential reversal zone matters, and how to test the idea honestly.
- [Why Markets Sometimes Rally on Bad News](https://bestmt4ea.com/7-powerful-reasons-why-markets-rally-when-bad-news-comes-out-and-what-investors-should-know/): Why currency prices sometimes rise after a worse-than-expected release, how expectations and positioning drive the reaction, and how to test the idea safely.
